task.title: Make the expanded sidebar's category fold chevron big enough to hit
task.description: Follow-up from the review of "Make the rail's category fold button big enough to hit" (PR #174, 2026-10-10). The rail's fold button now has a 24px+ hit area, but the same .category-toggle in the EXPANDED sidebar is still about 19px (1.2rem), below WCAG 2.5.8 AA's 24px. The sidebar head row is 1.9rem, so a 24px target fits. Give it at least a 24x24 hit area without visibly changing the expanded sidebar's look more than needed (a larger transparent hit box is fine), and extend the behavioral guard test from PR #174 (desktop/test/category-toggle.test.js, the cascade helper in desktop/test/support/cascade.js) to cover the expanded mode too.
